740998.name: Deck Trial [event]
740998.text: A Deck Trial is an event in Act I and Kaycee's Mod of Inscryption. The player arrives at the mouth of a cave, with a strange beast within who offers to join the player if they pass one of its trials.

740984.name: Campfire [event]
740984.text: The Campfire is an Event in Act I of Inscryption. The player meets five survivors gathered around a fire. The survivors invite the player to warm one of their creatures by the fire to make it stronger, but not out of any good faith.

741052.name: Trees [terrain]

740994.name: Consumable Items [item]
740994.text: Consumable items are special objects that can be obtained in Act I, Act III, and Kaycee's Mod of Inscryption. They sit to the right of the game board, and may be used at any time during combat, providing various beneficial effects to the user.

740982.name: Boons [modifier]
740982.text: Boons are special attributes given to the player during Leshy's Trials in Act I of Inscryption. Boons change the way the final battle works, giving huge buffs to the player. However, these boons do not carry over into your next run if you die. For each trial you pass, three out of the 5 boons will be offered, and the player may choose one.

741016.name: Leshy's Trials [modifier]
741016.text: Before facing Leshy in battle in Act I, the player will be given the opportunity to gain up to two boons by passing trials. The player will have to choose between three different trials. In a trial, three cards will be drawn, and at least one of them must satisfy the trial criteria.

740986.name: Card Battle [event]
740986.text: A Card Battle is the term for a normal battle in Inscryption, taking place in all three Acts & Kaycee's Mod. Battles behave slightly different depending on the Act, but the core gameplay is the same.

740990.name: Card Recycle [event]
740990.text: Card Recycle is an event in Act III that allows you to remove a card from your deck in exchange for Robobucks. All cards give 4 Robobucks by default, and give an additional 3 Robobucks for each additional Sigil placed onto them. The source of the Sigil does not matter, however it is important to note that the Sigil must be added to the card. Sigils present on cards by default give no additional Robobucks. The Sigil Power of the individual Sigils does not influence the amount of Robobucks given. Unlike Build-a-Card, Gemifying a card does not give any additional Robobucks.

741003.name: Fish Hook [item]
741003.text: Rulebook: To the user: Hook one of my cards and take it as your own. You must have an empty space on your side to receive it. The Fish Hook is a consumable item in Act I. It allows you to pull one of your opponent's cards to your side of the board, placing it under your control. You must have an empty space on your side of the board in the same lane as the targeted card; if you do not, you cannot use the Fish Hook on that card.

740987.name: Card Choice [event]
740987.text: A Card Choice is an event in Act I, Kaycee's Mod and Act III of Inscryption. The player is given a choice of three Cards and must select one of them. In Act I and Kaycee's Mod, there are multiple variants that have specific purposes. If the player has a Clover, they can swap out the cards offered for a new selection.

741037.name: Special Dagger [item]
741037.text: The Special Dagger is an item in Act I of Inscryption. When used, it adds a weight worth 4 points to the scale in your favor, at the cost of your right eye. Your vision will be impaired for the rest of the battle, but Leshy will let you choose a new eye when it ends. It is semi-unique, as while you can obtain it several times in a run, you can never have more than one copy of the Dagger at any given time.

740978.name: Boon of the Ambidextrous [modifier]
740978.text: |alt=]] The Boon of the Ambidextrous is a Boon given to the player during Leshy's Trials in Act I of Inscryption. This boon allows you to draw twice at the beginning of your turn, from either deck. This helps heighten your chances of getting good cards from your normal deck, or can draw twice from your Side Deck to get more sacrifice outlets. However, this also helps drain cards, causing Starvation to come in quicker.

740981.name: Boon of the Magpie's Eye [modifier]
740981.text: |alt=]] The Boon of the Magpie's Eye is a Boon given to the player during Leshy's Trials in Act I. This boon allows the player to, when drawing from their deck, chose any card from their deck to draw. This bypasses the randomness and risk of drawing from your deck, hoping for a powerful card. This mimics the Hoarder ability on the Magpie card, hence the name of the boon.

741009.name: Hammer [item]
741009.text: The Hammer is a tool in Act II and Act III of Inscryption. It can be used on any card on the player's side, including terrain cards, dealing 100 damage to said card. If used on a card with Nano Armor, it will break the Nano Armor first. It will also activate any on death abilities, such as Latchers, Unkillable, and Detonator, assuming the card actually dies from the hit.

740979.name: Boon of the Bone Lord [modifier]
740979.text: |alt=]] The Boon of the Bone Lord is a Boon given to the player during Leshy's Trials, or during the Bone Lord event if given a Black Goat in Act I of Inscryption. This boon gives the player 8 Bones at the start of all battles. This helps to easily play any bone card at the start of your turn.

740980.name: Boon of the Forest [modifier]
740980.text: |alt=]] The Boon of the Forest is a Boon given to the player during Leshy's Trials in Act I of Inscryption. This boon places Grand Firs on all your spaces at the start of the final battle. This gives you a good amount of time to draw cards and plan for the next few turns, and if the trees are not destroyed by your 3rd turn, they will be turned into Gold Nuggets and provide further protection.

741014.name: Kaycee's Mod [modifier]
741014.text: Kaycee's Mod is an official expansion to Act I of Inscryption, modifying the Act into a repeatable roguelike with many unlocks and challenges. It is accessible from the main menu upon beating the game.
